rationale: C25 plausibly supplied the administrative template later adapted in the child: a presidential letter concerning mobilization manpower directs the Civil Service Commission to guide executive departments and agencies, obtain and maintain agency-generated personnel information, and coordinate implementation across government. The child changes the immediate objective from conserving current personnel to maintaining rosters of former and outside specialists, but retains materially similar government-wide machinery. C03 is relevant for its defense-personnel instructions to the Commission, while C22 shares the same recipient and a Commission-led, interagency personnel initiative, but neither parallels the child's operative mechanism as closely as C25.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I would appreciate your requesting appropriate departments and agencies as a part of their manpower planning activities for both regular and mobilization programs to maintain suitable rosters
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I want you, together with the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission, to issue instructions on steps which can be taken to conserve manpower, and to advise and consult with the departments and agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both use the Civil Service Commission to direct and guide a government-wide manpower initiative implemented by individual departments and agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: These rosters should be maintained under such general guidance as you find necessary
shared_material.parent_excerpt: request reports from all departments and agencies and conduct regular inspections and surveys
shared_material.explanation: Both contemplate Commission oversight and continuing collection or review of personnel-related information from agencies rather than a one-time advisory act.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In determining, from time to time, the talents and competence most needed for existing and potential major defense mobilization programs, please consult the Bureau of the Budget
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I want you, together with the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission, to issue instructions... I am also asking that the Bureau of the Budget and the Civil Service Commission request reports
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the earlier joint role of the Civil Service Commission and Bureau of the Budget in administering a mobilization-manpower program.
